lines.text: Your opponent isn't faster than you.
He just sees your punch before you throw it.
Watch your right hand. Before it goes forward, it pulls back.
So how do you hide it?
Throw from where your hand already is. No pull-back.
Exhale, snap it out, and bring it back the same way.
Hide the start, and every punch looks faster, without being faster.
Drill it. Have someone call a number, and fire straight from your guard.
Who has the fastest hands ever?
